segments.name: Banking
segments.description: A financial holding company providing lending, leasing, trust and deposit services to commercial and retail customers through its bank subsidiary.
segments.evidence: The Corporation operates as a single segment entity for financial reporting purposes and adopted ASU 2023-07, Segment Reporting , for the year ended December 31, 2024.

revenueModel.text: The Corporation earns interest and fees from borrowers on loans, servicing fees on sold mortgage loans, and other service charges from banking customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Servicing fee income, which is included in Other Service Charges and Fees on the income statement, is for fees earned for servicing loans.
